"""Cache archive.org CDX listings for jrtcabreeders.com."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "jrtcabreeders.com"
API = ROOT / "api"
API.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
UA = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 jrtca-results-research"}

URLS = [
    "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=jrtcabreeders.com/*&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&filter=mimetype:text/html&fl=timestamp,original,mimetype,statuscode,digest,length",
    "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=www.jrtcabreeders.com/*&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&filter=mimetype:text/html&fl=timestamp,original,mimetype,statuscode,digest,length",
]


def fetch(url: str):
    print("CDX", url)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    print(" rows", len(data))
    return data


def main() -> None:
    combined = []
    seen = set()
    for url in URLS:
        rows = fetch(url)
        header, body = rows[0], rows[1:]
        if not combined:
            combined.append(header)
        for row in body:
            key = (row[0], row[1], row[4] if len(row) > 4 else "")
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            combined.append(row)
    out = API / "cdx.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(combined), encoding="utf-8")
    print("unique rows", len(combined) - 1, "->", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def unique_snapshots(rows: list[list[str]]) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """(timestamp, original_url, digest) unique by digest+url path."""
    skip = re.compile(
        r"/wp-(?:json|content|includes|admin|login)|/feed|/xmlrpc|/comments|"
        r"/page/\d+|/\?s=|/tag/|/author/",
        re.I,
    )
    seen_digest: set[str] = set()
    out: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for row in rows:
        if len(row) < 5:
            continue
        ts, original, _mt, _st, digest = row[:5]
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(original)
        path = parsed.path.lower().rstrip("/")
        if skip.search(original) or skip.search(path):
            continue
        slug = path.strip("/").split("/")[-1] if path else "home"
        if slug in SKIP_PAGES:
            continue

    keys = [normalize_key(name)]
    n = normalize_name(name)
    n = n.replace(" and ", " & ")
    if "&" in n:
        last = n.split()[-1]
        left, right = [x.strip() for x in n.split("&", 1)]
        if last.lower() not in left.lower().split():
            keys.append(normalize_key(f"{left} {last}"))
        keys.append(normalize_key(right))
        keys.append(normalize_key(left))
    # last name only is too loose; keep first+last
    parts = n.replace("&", " ").split()
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        keys.append(normalize_key(f"{parts[0]} {parts[-1]}"))
        keys.append(normalize_key(f"{parts[-2]} {parts[-1]}"))
    out = []
    seen = set()
    for k in keys:
        if k and k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            out.append(k)
    return out

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Parse archive HTML already on disk and augment existing Dog rows.

Runs separately from the Wayback downloader. Re-scans for new files so it can
keep a head start while snapshots are still arriving.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path

from scrape_jrtcabreeders import (
    PAGES_ARCHIVE,
    download_all_photos,
    dump_parsed,
    load_sql,
    merge_breeders,
    parse_existing_archive_files,
)

LOG = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "jrtcabreeders.com" / "archive_parse_headstart.log"


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    line = f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def process_batch() -> int:
    breeders, n_files = parse_existing_archive_files()
    if not n_files:
        return 0
    merged = merge_breeders(breeders)
    dog_n = sum(len(b.dogs) for b in merged)
    log(f"parsed {n_files} new files -> {len(merged)} kennels, {dog_n} dogs")
    download_all_photos(merged)
    dump_parsed(merged)
    load_sql(merged)
    return n_files


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="Parse current files only")
    ap.add_argument("--idle-rounds", type=int, default=40, help="Exit after this many empty scans")
    ap.add_argument("--sleep", type=int, default=20)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    log(f"head-start parser watching {PAGES_ARCHIVE}")
    on_disk = len(list(PAGES_ARCHIVE.glob('*.html')))
    log(f"{on_disk} html files already on disk")
    idle = 0
    while True:
        n = process_batch()
        if args.once:
            break
        if n == 0:
            idle += 1
            log(f"no new settled files ({idle}/{args.idle_rounds})")
            if idle >= args.idle_rounds:
                log("idle limit reached; exiting")
                break
        else:
            idle = 0
        time.sleep(args.sleep)
    log("head-start parser finished")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Parse archive HTML already on disk: update existing dogs and insert new ones.

Runs separately from the Wayback downloader. Re-scans for new files so it can
keep a head start while snapshots are still arriving.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path

from scrape_jrtcabreeders import (
    PAGES_ARCHIVE,
    cleanup_junk_sql,
    download_all_photos,
    dump_parsed,
    load_sql,
    merge_breeders,
    parse_existing_archive_files,
)

LOG = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "jrtcabreeders.com" / "archive_parse_headstart.log"


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    line = f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def process_batch(force: bool = False, skip_photos: bool = True) -> int:
    breeders, n_files = parse_existing_archive_files(force=force)
    if not n_files:
        return 0
    merged = merge_breeders(breeders)
    dog_n = sum(len(b.dogs) for b in merged)
    log(f"parsed {n_files} new files -> {len(merged)} kennels, {dog_n} dogs")
    dump_parsed(merged)
    log("loading SQL (update existing + insert new)")
    load_sql(merged)
    if skip_photos:
        log("SQL load finished; skipping photos")
    else:
        log("SQL load finished; downloading photos")
        download_all_photos(merged)
        log("photo pass finished")
    return n_files


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="Parse current files only")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Re-parse files already in the manifest")
    ap.add_argument("--photos", action="store_true", help="Download photos after SQL (off by default)")
    ap.add_argument("--idle-rounds", type=int, default=40, help="Exit after this many empty scans")
    ap.add_argument("--sleep", type=int, default=20)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    log(f"head-start parser watching {PAGES_ARCHIVE} (update existing + insert new)")
    on_disk = len(list(PAGES_ARCHIVE.glob("*.html")))
    log(f"{on_disk} html files already on disk")
    idle = 0
    first = True
    while True:
        n = process_batch(force=args.force and first, skip_photos=not args.photos)
        first = False
        if args.once:
            break
        if n == 0:
            idle += 1
            log(f"no new settled files ({idle}/{args.idle_rounds})")
            if idle >= args.idle_rounds:
                log("idle limit reached; exiting")
                break
        else:
            idle = 0
        time.sleep(args.sleep)
    log("head-start parser finished")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def tidy_dog_name(name: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    n = clean_piece(name)
    extra: list[str] = []
    dm = DATE_TAIL_RE.search(n)
    if dm:
        extra.append(dm.group(0).strip())
        n = clean_piece(n[: dm.start()])
    paren = re.search(r"\s*\(([^)]+)\)\s*$", n)
    if paren and re.search(r"NHC|WAA|BAER|CERF|PLL|co-?owned", paren.group(1), re.I):
        extra.append(paren.group(1))
        n = clean_piece(n[: paren.start()])
    base, rest = split_name_extras(n)
    if rest:
        extra.append(rest)
        n = base
    n = n.rstrip("?*").strip()
    return n, " ".join(extra)

input.contents:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Post-process jrtcabreeders load: junk/misnamed dogs, title case, missing kennels."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

from scrape_jrtcabreeders import (
    EMAIL_RE,
    PHONE_RE,
    SCRAPE_INSERT_MIN_ID,
    ST_RE,
    ZIP_RE,
    clip,
    fill_if_empty,
    get_conn,
    is_junk_row_name,
    looks_like_dog_name,
    merge_text,
    normalize_key,
)

JUNK_HEADER = re.compile(
    r"(home page|jack russells?$|pups?$|puppies|trio of|a few .+ puppies|"
    r"x .+ puppies|code of ethics|introduction)",
    re.I,
)
ADDR_NAME = re.compile(
    r"\d{3,}.+\b(AL|AK|AZ|AR|CA|CO|CT|DE|FL|GA|IA|ID|IL|IN|KS|KY|LA|MA|MD|ME|"
    r"MI|MN|MO|MS|MT|NC|ND|NE|NH|NJ|NM|NV|NY|OH|OK|OR|PA|RI|SC|SD|TN|TX|UT|"
    r"VA|VT|WA|WI|WV|WY)\b.+\d{5}",
    re.I,
)
SMALL = {"a", "an", "and", "at", "by", "for", "in", "of", "on", "or", "the", "to", "x"}
SKIP_PREFIX = {
    "the", "a", "an", "of", "and", "our", "my", "latest", "introducing",
    "unknown", "n/a", "none", "dog", "bitch", "male", "female",
}


def cap_word(word: str) -> str:
    if not word:
        return word
    if word in {"&", "/", "-"}:
        return word
    parts = re.split(r"(['’\-])", word)
    out = []
    for p in parts:
        if p in {"'", "’", "-"} or not p:
            out.append(p)
        else:
            out.append(p[0].upper() + p[1:].lower())
    return "".join(out)


def title_dog_name(name: str) -> str:
    n = (name or "").strip()
    if not n:
        return n
    letters = [c for c in n if c.isalpha()]
    if not letters or sum(c.isupper() for c in letters) / len(letters) < 0.75:
        return n
    low = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", n)
    prefix = ""
    rest = low
    if re.match(r"^NOMA\b", rest, re.I):
        prefix = "NOMA"
        rest = rest[4:].strip()
    elif re.match(r"^R\s*&\s*B\b", rest, re.I):
        prefix = "R&B"
        rest = re.sub(r"^R\s*&\s*B\b", "", rest, flags=re.I).strip()
    elif re.match(r"^J\s*&\s*J\b", rest, re.I):
        prefix = "J & J"
        rest = re.sub(r"^J\s*&\s*J\b", "", rest, flags=re.I).strip()
    words = rest.split() if rest else []
    titled = [cap_word(w) for w in words]
    if prefix and titled:
        return prefix + " " + " ".join(titled)
    if prefix:
        return prefix
    return " ".join(titled)


def merge_into(cur, src_id: int, dest_id: int, updates: dict) -> None:
    fill_if_empty(cur, "Dog", "DogID", dest_id, updates)
    if updates.get("Notes"):
        cur.execute("SELECT Notes FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=?", dest_id)
        row = cur.fetchone()
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE sResults.Dog SET Notes=? WHERE DogID=?",
            merge_text(row[0] if row else None, updates.get("Notes")),
            dest_id,
        )
    cur.execute(
        """
        UPDATE sResults.Relationship SET DogID=?
        WHERE DogID=? AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM sResults.Relationship r
            WHERE r.DogID=? AND r.RelatedDogName=sResults.Relationship.RelatedDogName
              AND r.RelationshipType=sResults.Relationship.RelationshipType
        )
        """,
        dest_id,
        src_id,
        dest_id,
    )
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Relationship WHERE DogID=? OR RelatedDogID=?", src_id, src_id)
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=?", src_id)


def fix_junk_and_misnamed(cur) -> dict:
    stats = {"deleted": 0, "merged": 0, "renamed": 0}
    cur.execute("SELECT DogID, Sire, Dam, Height, Coat, Color, Notes, SourceURL, BreederID FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=1263814")
    ruckus = cur.fetchone()
    if ruckus:
        merge_into(
            cur,
            1263814,
            1078297,
            {
                "Sire": ruckus[1],
                "Dam": ruckus[2],
                "Height": ruckus[3],
                "Coat": ruckus[4],
                "Color": ruckus[5],
                "Notes": ruckus[6],
                "SourceURL": ruckus[7],
                "BreederID": 87,
            },
        )
        stats["merged"] += 1
    cur.execute("SELECT DogID, Sire, Dam, Height, Coat, Color, Notes, SourceURL FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=1263816")
    luke = cur.fetchone()
    if luke:
        merge_into(
            cur,
            1263816,
            1078655,
            {
                "Sire": luke[1],
                "Dam": luke[2],
                "Height": luke[3],
                "Coat": luke[4],
                "Color": luke[5],
                "Notes": luke[6],
                "SourceURL": luke[7],
                "BreederID": 89,
            },
        )
        stats["merged"] += 1

    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT DogID, DogName, Sire, Dam FROM sResults.Dog
        WHERE DogID >= ?
        """,
        SCRAPE_INSERT_MIN_ID,
    )
    delete_ids = []
    for did, name, sire, dam in cur.fetchall():
        n = name or ""
        if did in {1263814, 1263816}:
            continue
        if ADDR_NAME.search(n) or JUNK_HEADER.search(n) or is_junk_row_name(n):
            if sire or dam:
                continue
            delete_ids.append(did)
    if delete_ids:
        marks = ",".join("?" * len(delete_ids))
        cur.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM sResults.Relationship WHERE DogID IN ({marks}) OR RelatedDogID IN ({marks})",
            delete_ids + delete_ids,
        )
        cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID IN ({marks})", delete_ids)
        stats["deleted"] = cur.rowcount or 0

    for bid in (48, 50, 51):
        cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=NULL WHERE BreederID=?", bid)
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?", bid)
    return stats


def title_case_new_dogs(cur) -> int:
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT DogID, DogName FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID >= ?",
        SCRAPE_INSERT_MIN_ID,
    )
    n = 0
    for did, name in cur.fetchall():
        new = title_dog_name(name or "")
        if new and new != name:
            cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Dog SET DogName=? WHERE DogID=?", new[:255], did)
            n += 1
    return n


def candidate_prefixes(name: str) -> list[str]:
    words = [w for w in re.split(r"\s+", (name or "").strip()) if w]
    if not words or words[0].lower().strip(".,") in SKIP_PREFIX:
        return []
    out = []
    if re.match(r"^(NOMA|R&B|R\s*&\s*B|J\s*&\s*J)\b", name, re.I):
        if re.match(r"^NOMA\b", name, re.I):
            out.append("NOMA")
        elif re.match(r"^R\s*&\s*B\b", name, re.I):
            out.append("R&B")
        else:
            out.append("J & J")
    if len(words) >= 2:
        out.append(" ".join(words[:2]))
    if len(words) >= 3 and words[1].lower() not in SMALL:
        out.append(" ".join(words[:3]))
    if len(words) >= 1:
        out.append(words[0])
    seen = set()
    uniq = []
    for p in out:
        k = normalize_key(p)
        if k and k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            uniq.append(p)
    return uniq


def extrapolate_missing_kennels(cur) -> list[dict]:
    cur.execute("SELECT BreederID, KennelName, OwnerName FROM sResults.Breeder")
    breeders = cur.fetchall()
    have = {normalize_key(n): (bid, n, own) for bid, n, own in breeders if n}
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT d.DogName, o.OwnerName, d.OwnerID, d.BreederID
        FROM sResults.Dog d
        LEFT JOIN sResults.Owner o ON d.OwnerID = o.OwnerID
        WHERE d.DogName IS NOT NULL AND LEN(d.DogName) > 3
        """
    )
    prefix_dogs = defaultdict(list)
    for dname, oname, oid, bid in cur.fetchall():
        for p in candidate_prefixes(dname):
            prefix_dogs[normalize_key(p)].append((p, oname, oid, bid))

    missing = []
    for key, rows in prefix_dogs.items():
        if key in have:
            continue
        if len(rows) < 8:
            continue
        display = Counter(p for p, *_ in rows).most_common(1)[0][0]
        if display.lower() in SKIP_PREFIX or len(display) < 3:
            continue
        owners = Counter(
            o.strip() for _, o, _, _ in rows if o and len(o.strip()) > 3 and "@" not in o
        )
        owner = owners.most_common(1)[0][0] if owners else None
        owner_n = owners.most_common(1)[0][1] if owners else 0
        if owner and owner_n < 2:
            owner = None
        missing.append(
            {
                "kennel": display,
                "key": key,
                "dogs": len(rows),
                "owner": owner,
                "owner_n": owner_n,
            }
        )
    missing.sort(key=lambda x: -x["dogs"])
    return missing


def insert_missing_breeders(cur, missing: list[dict]) -> int:
    n = 0
    for rec in missing:
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT BreederID FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE KennelName=?",
            rec["kennel"],
        )
        if cur.fetchone():
            continue
        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO sResults.Breeder (KennelName, KennelPrefix, OwnerName, Notes)
            OUTPUT INSERTED.BreederID
            VALUES (?,?,?,?)
            """,
            rec["kennel"][:255],
            rec["kennel"][:100],
            rec["owner"],
            f"Extrapolated from {rec['dogs']} dog names"
            + (f"; owner seen {rec['owner_n']} times" if rec["owner"] else ""),
        )
        bid = cur.fetchone()[0]
        rec["breeder_id"] = bid
        n += 1
        prefix = rec["kennel"] + " "
        cur.execute(
            """
            UPDATE d SET d.BreederID = COALESCE(d.BreederID, ?)
            FROM sResults.Dog d
            WHERE d.BreederID IS NULL AND (
                d.DogName LIKE ? OR d.DogName LIKE ?
            )
            """,
            bid,
            rec["kennel"],
            prefix + "%",
        )
    return n


def apply_web_facts(cur, breeder_id: int, facts: dict) -> None:
    fill_if_empty(
        cur,
        "Breeder",
        "BreederID",
        breeder_id,
        {
            "Address": clip(facts.get("address"), 255),
            "City": clip(facts.get("city"), 100),
            "State": clip(facts.get("state"), 50),
            "PostalCode": clip(facts.get("postal"), 20),
            "Email": clip(facts.get("email"), 255),
            "Phone": clip(facts.get("phone"), 100),
            "Website": clip(facts.get("website"), 500),
            "OwnerName": clip(facts.get("owner"), 255),
        },
    )


def main() -> None:
    conn = get_conn()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    junk = fix_junk_and_misnamed(cur)
    print("junk/misnamed", junk)
    titled = title_case_new_dogs(cur)
    print("title-cased", titled)
    missing = extrapolate_missing_kennels(cur)
    print("missing kennel prefixes", len(missing))
    for rec in missing[:40]:
        print(f"  {rec['dogs']:4d}  {rec['kennel']!r}  owner={rec['owner']!r} ({rec['owner_n']})")
    inserted = insert_missing_breeders(cur, missing)
    print("inserted breeders", inserted)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    ( __import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).parent / "jrtcabreeders.com" / "missing_kennels.txt"
    ).write_text(
        "\n".join(
            f"{r['dogs']}\t{r['kennel']}\t{r.get('owner') or ''}\t{r.get('breeder_id') or ''}"
            for r in missing
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply user-provided Breeder cleanup list."""
from __future__ import annotations

from enrich_jrtcabreeders import best_owner_for_kennel, fold_kennel
from scrape_jrtcabreeders import get_conn

cn = get_conn()
cur = cn.cursor()


def find_by_name(*names: str) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    out = []
    for n in names:
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT BreederID, KennelName FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE KennelName=?",
            n,
        )
        out.extend(cur.fetchall())
    return out


def find_fold(target: str) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    t = fold_kennel(target)
    cur.execute("SELECT BreederID, KennelName FROM sResults.Breeder")
    return [(b, n) for b, n in cur.fetchall() if fold_kennel(n or "") == t]


def ensure_kennel(name: str, owner: str | None = None, notes: str = "User-corrected kennel") -> int:
    rows = find_by_name(name) or find_fold(name)
    if rows:
        bid = rows[0][0]
        if owner:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE sResults.Breeder SET OwnerName=? WHERE BreederID=?",
                owner[:255],
                bid,
            )
        return bid
    cur.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO sResults.Breeder (KennelName, KennelPrefix, OwnerName, Notes)
        OUTPUT INSERTED.BreederID VALUES (?,?,?,?)
        """,
        name[:255],
        name[:100],
        owner,
        notes,
    )
    return cur.fetchone()[0]


def merge_into(dest_id: int, src_ids: list[int]) -> None:
    for sid in src_ids:
        if sid == dest_id:
            continue
        cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=? WHERE BreederID=?", dest_id, sid)
        cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Owner SET BreederID=? WHERE BreederID=?", dest_id, sid)
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?", sid)
        print(f"  merge {sid} -> {dest_id}")


def delete_kennel(bid: int) -> None:
    cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=NULL WHERE BreederID=?", bid)
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?", bid)
    print(f"  delete kennel {bid}")


def link_dogs(prefix: str, bid: int) -> None:
    cur.execute(
        """
        UPDATE sResults.Dog
        SET BreederID = COALESCE(BreederID, ?)
        WHERE DogName = ? OR DogName LIKE ?
        """,
        bid,
        prefix,
        prefix + " %",
    )


stats = {"merged": 0, "deleted": 0, "fixed_owner": 0, "created": 0}

# --- dog-name kennels -> real prefix ---
dog_to_kennel = [
    # (dog kennel names to remove, real kennel, owner override)
    (["Brooks Chase Red", "Brooks Chase Twist-N-Shout"], "Brooks Chase", "Joe Shapiro & Brooks Kelley"),
    (["Camerton Hall Velocity"], "Camerton Hall", None),
    (["Dancin' Bear"], None, None),  # delete only
    (["Meadowlake Woody"], "Meadowlake", None),
    (["Reynard's Folly Sterling", "Reynard’s Folly Sterling"], "Reynard's Folly", None),
    (["Sow's Ear White"], "Sow's Ear", "Karen McCarthy"),
    (["Tambralee Cajun"], "Tambralee", "Brandon & Tammy Cormier"),
    (["Whispering Winds Sir"], "Whispering Winds", None),
    (["R.A. Dixie", "R.A. George", "R.A. Lucky", "R.A. Sundance"], "R.A.", "Arnaldo Mellado"),
    (["Jack B Quick", "Jack BQuick", "Jacks B Quick", "Jacks BQuick", "Jack Be"], None, None),
]

for names, kennel, owner in dog_to_kennel:
    src = []
    for n in names:
        src.extend(find_by_name(n))
    if kennel is None:
        for bid, n in src:
            delete_kennel(bid)
            stats["deleted"] += 1
        continue
    dest = ensure_kennel(kennel, owner)
    if owner:
        stats["fixed_owner"] += 1
    merge_into(dest, [b for b, _ in src])
    link_dogs(kennel, dest)
    # also link dogs matching the removed names as dog names
    for _bid, n in src:
        link_dogs(n, dest)
    stats["merged"] += len(src)
    print(f"dogs->{kennel!r}: {[n for _, n in src]}")

# --- spelling / abbreviation merges (src names -> keep name) ---
merges = [
    (["Catawaba Mountain", "Catawba Mt.", "Catawba Mtn."], "Catawba Mountain", "Sandra, Norman & Lori King"),
    (["Dig Em Out", "Dig'Em Out", "Dig EmOut"], "DigEmOut", "Janon Frei"),
    (["Herford Hills"], "Hereford Hills", "Eric & Gwen Dunn"),
    (["House O'Jacks", "House O’Jacks"], "House O' Jacks", None),
    (["Jack’n Around", "Jack'n Around", "Jackn Around"], "Jack'n Around", "Sarah Williams"),
    (["Leap 'N Jack", "Leap'N Jack", "Leapin' Jack", "Leap 'N Jack"], None, None),  # dogs; keep Leap'n River
    (["Leap’n River", "Leap'n River"], "Leap'n River", "Kymberly Wheeler"),
    (["Orhcard Hill"], "Orchard Hill", "Cheryl & Robby Robson"),
    (["Point of View", "Point Of View"], "PointofView", 'K.L. "Bud" & Judy Moomau'),
    (["Saw's Ear", "Sow' Ear", "Sows Ear"], "Sow's Ear", "Karen McCarthy"),
    (["Treon Quarry"], "Troon Quarry", "Sue & Elizabeth Murphree"),
    (["Watz B", "Watz B Happn'n"], "Watzb Happn'n", "Carol Bowser"),
    (["Jack Co."], "Jack Company", "Colleen Groce"),
    (["Sass'N Dash", "Sass N'Dash", "Sass N Dash"], "Sass 'N Dash", "Joan Crouse"),
]

for src_names, keep, owner in merges:
    if keep is None:
        # Leap*Jack are dogs under no kennel or Leap'n River? User said Leap'n River is kennel;
        # Leap'N Jack entries are separate-looking - treat as dog kennels to delete
        for n in src_names:
            for bid, _ in find_by_name(n):
                # reassign dogs named like this to Leap'n River if name starts with Leap
                river = ensure_kennel("Leap'n River", "Kymberly Wheeler")
                cur.execute(
                    """
                    UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=?
                    WHERE BreederID=? AND (DogName LIKE 'Leap%' OR DogName LIKE 'Leap''%')
                    """,
                    river,
                    bid,
                )
                delete_kennel(bid)
                stats["deleted"] += 1
        continue
    keep_rows = find_by_name(keep) or find_fold(keep)
    if not keep_rows:
        dest = ensure_kennel(keep, owner)
        stats["created"] += 1
    else:
        dest = keep_rows[0][0]
        if owner:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE sResults.Breeder SET OwnerName=? WHERE BreederID=?",
                owner[:255],
                dest,
            )
            stats["fixed_owner"] += 1
    src_ids = []
    for n in src_names:
        src_ids.extend([b for b, _ in find_by_name(n)])
    # also fold-match variants
    for bid, name in find_fold(keep):
        if bid != dest and fold_kennel(name) == fold_kennel(keep):
            src_ids.append(bid)
    for n in src_names:
        for bid, name in find_fold(n):
            if bid != dest:
                src_ids.append(bid)
    src_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(src_ids))
    merge_into(dest, src_ids)
    link_dogs(keep, dest)
    stats["merged"] += len(src_ids)
    print(f"merge->{keep!r}: {src_ids}")

# --- junk delete ---
for n in ["Suitability -", "Suitability-", "TIE -"]:
    for bid, _ in find_by_name(n):
        delete_kennel(bid)
        stats["deleted"] += 1

# --- owner fixes ---
owner_fixes = [
    (91, "Joe Shapiro & Brooks Kelley"),  # Brooks Chase if id known - find by name
    ("Brooks Chase", "Joe Shapiro & Brooks Kelley"),
    ("Natural Instinct", "Ken & Kathy Bushell"),
    ("Sow's Ear", "Karen McCarthy"),
    ("Tambralee", "Brandon & Tammy Cormier"),
    ("R.A.", "Arnaldo Mellado"),
    ("Drumlins", None),  # clear HTML then best_owner
    ("Dynamic Duo", None),
    ("Eagles Nest", None),
]

for key, owner in owner_fixes:
    if isinstance(key, int):
        rows = [(key, None)]
    else:
        rows = find_by_name(key) or find_fold(key)
    for bid, _n in rows:
        if owner:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE sResults.Breeder SET OwnerName=? WHERE BreederID=?",
                owner[:255],
                bid,
            )
        else:
            # clear junk and refill
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE sResults.Breeder SET OwnerName=NULL WHERE BreederID=?",
                bid,
            )
            kennel = cur.execute(
                "SELECT KennelName FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?", bid
            ).fetchone()[0]
            best = best_owner_for_kennel(cur, bid, kennel)
            if best:
                cur.execute(
                    "UPDATE sResults.Breeder SET OwnerName=? WHERE BreederID=?",
                    best,
                    bid,
                )
        stats["fixed_owner"] += 1
        print(f"owner {bid} -> {owner or 'best'}")

# HTML owners still messed up
cur.execute(
    """
    SELECT BreederID, KennelName, OwnerName FROM sResults.Breeder
    WHERE OwnerName LIKE '%>%' OR OwnerName LIKE '%<%'
       OR OwnerName LIKE '%Handwriting%' OR OwnerName LIKE '%Buddies%'
       OR OwnerName LIKE '%cherished%' OR OwnerName LIKE '%Natural Instinct Micro%'
    """
)
for bid, kennel, old in cur.fetchall():
    best = best_owner_for_kennel(cur, bid, kennel)
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE sResults.Breeder SET OwnerName=? WHERE BreederID=?",
        best,
        bid,
    )
    print(f"html-owner {bid} {kennel!r}: {old!r} -> {best!r}")
    stats["fixed_owner"] += 1

cn.commit()
print("STATS", stats)

# verify
checks = [
    "Brooks Chase",
    "Camerton Hall",
    "Catawba Mountain",
    "DigEmOut",
    "Hereford Hills",
    "House O' Jacks",
    "Jack'n Around",
    "Jack Company",
    "Leap'n River",
    "Meadowlake",
    "Natural Instinct",
    "Orchard Hill",
    "PointofView",
    "R.A.",
    "Reynard's Folly",
    "Sow's Ear",
    "Tambralee",
    "Troon Quarry",
    "Watzb Happn'n",
    "Whispering Winds",
    "Dancin' Bear",
    "Suitability -",
    "Meadowlake Woody",
    "R.A. Dixie",
    "Bear Trace",
]
print("--- verify ---")
for c in checks:
    print(c, find_by_name(c) or find_fold(c))

    # if an exact Copper Moon name already exists under KEEP, merge into that dog
    existing = cur.execute(

        new,

        # relink relationships / results if present

from __future__ import annotations

from enrich_jrtcabreeders import fold_kennel, get_conn

cn = get_conn()
cur = cn.cursor()

cur.execute(
    "SELECT BreederID, KennelName FROM sResults.Breeder "
    "WHERE KennelName IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(KennelName)) <> ''"
)
breeders = [(bid, (name or "").strip()) for bid, name in cur.fetchall()]
# Longest kennel first so "Broken Arrow" beats "Broken"
breeders.sort(key=lambda x: (-len(x[1]), x[1].lower()))

# Build fold -> list of (bid, display) for ambiguity checks
by_fold: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str]]] = {}
for bid, name in breeders:
    fk = fold_kennel(name)
    if not fk:
        continue
    by_fold.setdefault(fk, []).append((bid, name))

print("breeders", len(breeders), "unique folds", len(by_fold))

cur.execute(
    """
    SELECT DogID, DogName
    FROM sResults.Dog
    WHERE BreederID IS NULL
      AND DogName IS NOT NULL
      AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(DogName))) >= 4
    """
)
dogs = cur.fetchall()
print("null-breeder dogs to scan", len(dogs))

linked = 0
ambiguous = 0
no_match = 0
samples: list[tuple] = []
amb_samples: list[tuple] = []

# Precompute folded kennel list sorted by length for matching
folded_sorted = sorted(
    ((fold_kennel(n), bid, n) for bid, n in breeders if fold_kennel(n)),
    key=lambda x: (-len(x[0]), x[0]),
)

BATCH = []
for dog_id, dname in dogs:
    raw = (dname or "").strip()
    if not raw or raw[0] in "\"'(-!&":
        no_match += 1
        continue
    # strip leading quotes/parens leftovers
    dn = raw
    fold_dog = fold_kennel(dn)
    if not fold_dog:
        no_match += 1
        continue

    match = None  # (bid, kennel, fold)
    for fk, bid, display in folded_sorted:
        # dog fold must start with kennel fold as whole words
        if fold_dog == fk or fold_dog.startswith(fk + " "):
            # ambiguity: other breeders with same fold?
            alts = by_fold.get(fk, [])
            if len(alts) > 1:
                ambiguous += 1
                if len(amb_samples) < 15:
                    amb_samples.append((dog_id, dn, [(a[0], a[1]) for a in alts]))
                match = None
                break
            match = (bid, display, fk)
            break

    if not match:
        if match is None and not any(
            fold_dog == fk or fold_dog.startswith(fk + " ")
            for fk, _, _ in folded_sorted
        ):
            no_match += 1
        continue

    bid, display, fk = match
    BATCH.append((bid, dog_id))
    linked += 1
    if len(samples) < 25:
        samples.append((dog_id, dn, bid, display))

    if len(BATCH) >= 500:
        cur.fast_executemany = True
        cur.executemany(
            "UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=? WHERE DogID=? AND BreederID IS NULL",
            BATCH,
        )
        BATCH.clear()

if BATCH:
    cur.fast_executemany = True
    cur.executemany(
        "UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=? WHERE DogID=? AND BreederID IS NULL",
        BATCH,
    )

cn.commit()

still_null = cur.execute(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sResults.Dog WHERE BreederID IS NULL"
).fetchval()

print("linked", linked)
print("ambiguous skipped", ambiguous)
print("no match / junk", no_match)
print("still null BreederID", still_null)
print("samples:")
for s in samples:
    print(" ", s)
print("ambiguous samples:")
for s in amb_samples:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Set Dog.BreederID from kennel-name prefix match when BreederID is NULL.

Includes single-word kennels (DigEmOut, Seaview, …) with a length floor to
avoid ultra-short false positives. Prefers longest kennel prefix.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

from enrich_jrtcabreeders import SKIP_PREFIX, fold_kennel, get_conn

# Single-word kennels shorter than this are too collision-prone (Fox, Ace, …)
MIN_SINGLE_WORD_LEN = 4

cn = get_conn()
cur = cn.cursor()

breeders = cur.execute(
    "SELECT BreederID, KennelName FROM sResults.Breeder "
    "WHERE KennelName IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(KennelName)) <> ''"
).fetchall()

by_fold: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str]]] = {}
for bid, name in breeders:
    display = (name or "").strip()
    fk = fold_kennel(display)
    if not fk:
        continue
    words = fk.split()
    if len(words) == 1:
        if len(fk) < MIN_SINGLE_WORD_LEN:
            continue
        if fk.lower() in SKIP_PREFIX:
            continue
    by_fold.setdefault(fk, []).append((bid, display))

folded_sorted = sorted(by_fold.keys(), key=lambda s: (-len(s), s))
dog_counts = {
    bid: n
    for bid, n in cur.execute(
        "SELECT BreederID, COUNT(*) FROM sResults.Dog "
        "WHERE BreederID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BreederID"
    ).fetchall()
}

print("usable kennel folds", len(by_fold))

dogs = cur.execute(
    """
    SELECT DogID, DogName
    FROM sResults.Dog
    WHERE BreederID IS NULL
      AND DogName IS NOT NULL
      AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(DogName))) >= 3
    """
).fetchall()
print("null-breeder dogs to scan", len(dogs))

# Optional: strip a leading entry# / place token like "504 All Terrain Logan"
LEADING_JUNK = re.compile(
    r"^(?:"
    r"\(tie\)\s*-?\s*"
    r"|\d{1,4}\s+"
    r"|\"[^\"]+\"\s+"
    r")+",
    re.I,
)


def dog_fold_candidates(raw: str) -> list[str]:
    raw = raw.strip()
    cands = []
    fd = fold_kennel(raw)
    if fd:
        cands.append(fd)
    stripped = LEADING_JUNK.sub("", raw).strip()
    if stripped and stripped != raw:
        fd2 = fold_kennel(stripped)
        if fd2 and fd2 not in cands:
            cands.append(fd2)
    return cands


linked = 0
ambiguous = 0
no_match = 0
samples: list[tuple] = []
BATCH: list[tuple[int, int]] = []


def flush():
    if not BATCH:
        return
    cur.fast_executemany = True
    cur.executemany(
        "UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=? WHERE DogID=? AND BreederID IS NULL",
        BATCH,
    )
    BATCH.clear()


for dog_id, dname in dogs:
    raw = (dname or "").strip()
    if not raw or raw[0] in "&=<[":
        no_match += 1
        continue
    cands = dog_fold_candidates(raw)
    if not cands:
        no_match += 1
        continue

    found_fk = None
    for fd in cands:
        for fk in folded_sorted:
            if fd == fk or fd.startswith(fk + " "):
                found_fk = fk
                break
        if found_fk:
            break

    if not found_fk:
        no_match += 1
        continue

    alts = by_fold[found_fk]
    if len(alts) > 1:
        scored = sorted(
            ((dog_counts.get(bid0, 0), bid0, disp0) for bid0, disp0 in alts),
            reverse=True,
        )
        if scored[0][0] == scored[1][0]:
            ambiguous += 1
            continue
        bid, display = scored[0][1], scored[0][2]
    else:
        bid, display = alts[0]

    BATCH.append((bid, dog_id))
    dog_counts[bid] = dog_counts.get(bid, 0) + 1
    linked += 1
    if len(samples) < 40:
        samples.append((dog_id, raw, bid, display))
    if len(BATCH) >= 400:
        flush()

flush()
cn.commit()

still_null = cur.execute(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sResults.Dog WHERE BreederID IS NULL"
).fetchval()
with_b = cur.execute(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sResults.Dog WHERE BreederID IS NOT NULL"
).fetchval()

print("linked this run", linked)
print("ambiguous skipped", ambiguous)
print("no match", no_match)
print("still null BreederID", still_null)
print("dogs with BreederID", with_b)
print("samples:")
for s in samples:
    print(" ", s)

# Focus: dog matches some multi-word kennel longer/better than current assignment

"""Clean Breeder Address/City/State/PostalCode/Location junk and mixups."""
from __future__ import annotations
import re
from enrich_jrtcabreeders import get_conn, fill_if_empty, clip

US = {
 'AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD',
 'MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC',
 'SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY','DC'
}
CA = {'AB','BC','MB','NB','NL','NS','NT','NU','ON','PE','QC','SK','YT'}
OK = US | CA

STATE_NAMES = {
 'alabama':'AL','alaska':'AK','arizona':'AZ','arkansas':'AR','california':'CA','colorado':'CO',
 'connecticut':'CT','delaware':'DE','florida':'FL','georgia':'GA','hawaii':'HI','idaho':'ID',
 'illinois':'IL','indiana':'IN','iowa':'IA','kansas':'KS','kentucky':'KY','louisiana':'LA',
 'maine':'ME','maryland':'MD','massachusetts':'MA','michigan':'MI','minnesota':'MN',
 'mississippi':'MS','missouri':'MO','montana':'MT','nebraska':'NE','nevada':'NV',
 'new hampshire':'NH','new jersey':'NJ','new mexico':'NM','new york':'NY','north carolina':'NC',
 'north dakota':'ND','ohio':'OH','oklahoma':'OK','oregon':'OR','pennsylvania':'PA',
 'rhode island':'RI','south carolina':'SC','south dakota':'SD','tennessee':'TN','texas':'TX',
 'utah':'UT','vermont':'VT','virginia':'VA','washington':'WA','west virginia':'WV',
 'wisconsin':'WI','wyoming':'WY','district of columbia':'DC',
 'ontario':'ON','quebec':'QC','british columbia':'BC','alberta':'AB','manitoba':'MB',
 'saskatchewan':'SK','nova scotia':'NS','new brunswick':'NB','prince edward island':'PE',
 # typos seen in scrape
 'missiouri':'MO','pennsylvannia':'PA','pensylvania':'PA','massachussets':'MA',
 'californa':'CA','tennesee':'TN','west virgina':'WV',
}

PHONE_RE = re.compile(r'^\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}$')
EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r'^(?:Email:\s*)?([\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+)$', re.I)
HEIGHT_RE = re.compile(r'^\d{1,2}"?\s*$')
HTML_RE = re.compile(r'(?i)(font\s*size|size\s*=|face\s*=|<|>| |arial)')
PEDIGREE_RE = re.compile(r'(?i)\bx\b|\(.*\)|^\s*>')
STREET_HINT = re.compile(
    r'(?i)\b(st|street|rd|road|ave|avenue|ln|lane|dr|drive|blvd|way|ct|court|cir|circle|'
    r'hwy|highway|po box|p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|route|rt|rr|county road|cr|box)\b'
)
ZIP_RE = re.compile(r'^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$')
CAN_ZIP = re.compile(r'^[A-Z]\d[A-Z]\s?\d[A-Z]\d$', re.I)

def norm_state(s: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not s:
        return None
    t = s.strip().strip(',').strip('-').strip()
    if not t:
        return None
    u = t.upper().replace('.', '')
    if u in {'USA', 'US', 'UNITED STATES', 'CANADA', 'UK', 'AUSTRALIA', 'ENGLAND'}:
        return None  # country, not state
    if u in OK:
        return u
    key = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t.lower())
    if key in STATE_NAMES:
        return STATE_NAMES[key]
    return t  # leave unknown for later junk clear

def parse_location(loc: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
    """Parse 'City, ST' or 'City, State' or 'City, Province, Canada'."""
    if not loc:
        return None, None
    t = loc.strip()
    t = re.sub(r'\s*-\s*Canada\s*$', '', t, flags=re.I)
    t = re.sub(r',\s*Canada\s*$', '', t, flags=re.I)
    t = t.strip(' ,-')
    if not t:
        return None, None
    # City, ST
    m = re.match(r'^(.+?),\s*([A-Za-z]{2})$', t)
    if m:
        st = norm_state(m.group(2))
        if st and st in OK:
            return m.group(1).strip(), st
    # City, FullState
    m = re.match(r'^(.+?),\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z .]+)$', t)
    if m:
        st = norm_state(m.group(2))
        if st and st in OK:
            return m.group(1).strip(), st
    # City only if it's a known state name mistakenly
    st = norm_state(t)
    if st and st in OK and t.lower() in STATE_NAMES:
        return None, st
    return t, None

def is_junk_address(a: str | None) -> bool:
    if not a or not a.strip():
        return True
    a = a.strip()
    if HEIGHT_RE.match(a):
        return True
    if HTML_RE.search(a):
        return True
    if PHONE_RE.match(a):
        return True
    if EMAIL_RE.match(a):
        return True
    if PEDIGREE_RE.search(a) and not STREET_HINT.search(a):
        return True
    # dog-name-like: no digits, no street hint, shortish
    if not re.search(r'\d', a) and not STREET_HINT.search(a) and len(a) < 60:
        # allow RR #2 style already caught by STREET_HINT (rr)
        # bare city fragments unlikely alone if we already have city
        words = a.split()
        if len(words) <= 4 and not a.lower().startswith('rr'):
            return True
    if a in {'None', 'n/a', 'N/A', '-', '.'}:
        return True
    return False

def strip_trailing_city(addr: str, city: str) -> str:
    if not addr or not city:
        return addr
    a = addr.strip()
    c = city.strip()
    # exact trailing city
    if a.lower().endswith(c.lower()):
        trimmed = a[: len(a) - len(c)].rstrip(' ,')
        if trimmed and (re.search(r'\d', trimmed) or STREET_HINT.search(trimmed)):
            return trimmed
    return a

def clean_city_field(city: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]:
    """Returns (city, state_from_city, email_if_any)."""
    if not city:
        return None, None, None
    t = city.strip()
    m = EMAIL_RE.match(t)
    if m or t.lower().startswith('email:'):
        em = m.group(1) if m else t.split(':', 1)[-1].strip()
        return None, None, em
    # "Brantford, Ontario -"
    t = re.sub(r'\s*-\s*$', '', t).strip()
    if ',' in t:
        # may be "City, Province" or "City, State OtherCity"
        parts = [p.strip() for p in t.split(',')]
        left = parts[0]
        right = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        # right may be "Ontario" or "Colorado New River" or "Ontario -"
        right = re.sub(r'\s*-\s*$', '', right).strip()
        # try full right as state
        st = norm_state(right)
        if st and st in OK:
            return left, st, None
        # try first word(s) of right as state name
        words = right.split()
        for n in range(min(3, len(words)), 0, -1):
            st = norm_state(' '.join(words[:n]))
            if st and st in OK:
                # leftover after state may be another city - ignore for city field
                return left, st, None
        return left, None, None
    st = norm_state(t)
    if st and st in OK and t.lower() in STATE_NAMES:
        return None, st, None
    return t, None, None

def fmt_location(city, state):
    if city and state:
        return f"{city}, {state}"
    if city:
        return city
    if state:
        return state
    return None

conn = get_conn()
conn.autocommit = False
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("""
SELECT BreederID, KennelName, Address, City, State, PostalCode, Location, Phone, Email, Notes
FROM sResults.Breeder
""")
rows = cur.fetchall()

stats = {
    'state_norm': 0, 'addr_cleared': 0, 'addr_stripped_city': 0,
    'city_from_loc': 0, 'city_cleaned': 0, 'email_rescued': 0,
    'phone_from_addr': 0, 'loc_updated': 0, 'zip_cleared': 0, 'touched': 0,
}
changes = []

for bid, kn, addr, city, state, zipc, loc, phone, email, notes in rows:
    orig = (addr, city, state, zipc, loc, phone, email)
    a = (addr or '').strip() or None
    ci = (city or '').strip() or None
    st = (state or '').strip() or None
    z = (zipc or '').strip() or None
    lo = (loc or '').strip() or None
    ph = (phone or '').strip() or None
    em = (email or '').strip() or None
    changed = False

    # Rescue phone stuck in address
    if a and PHONE_RE.match(a):
        if not ph:
            ph = re.sub(r'[^\d]', '', a)
            if len(ph) == 10:
                ph = f"({ph[:3]}){ph[3:6]}-{ph[6:]}"
            stats['phone_from_addr'] += 1
        a = None
        stats['addr_cleared'] += 1
        changed = True

    # Clean city / rescue email-in-city
    new_ci, st_from_city, em_from_city = clean_city_field(ci)
    if em_from_city:
        if not em:
            em = em_from_city
            stats['email_rescued'] += 1
        ci = None
        changed = True
        stats['city_cleaned'] += 1
    elif new_ci != ci or st_from_city:
        if new_ci != ci:
            ci = new_ci
            changed = True
            stats['city_cleaned'] += 1
        if st_from_city and (not st or norm_state(st) not in OK or st.lower() in ('canada',)):
            st = st_from_city
            changed = True

    # Normalize state
    st_n = norm_state(st)
    if st and st_n != st:
        if st_n is None or st_n in OK:
            st = st_n
            changed = True
            stats['state_norm'] += 1
        elif st_n not in OK:
            # unknown leftover - try location
            pass
    elif st and st_n and st_n in OK and st != st_n:
        st = st_n
        changed = True
        stats['state_norm'] += 1
    if st and norm_state(st) in OK:
        st = norm_state(st)

    # Parse location as backup for city/state
    loc_city, loc_state = parse_location(lo)
    if (not ci or (ci and '@' in (ci or ''))) and loc_city:
        ci = loc_city
        stats['city_from_loc'] += 1
        changed = True
    if (not st or st not in OK) and loc_state:

        changed = True
        stats['state_norm'] += 1

    # If city empty but location has it
    if not ci and loc_city:
        ci = loc_city
        stats['city_from_loc'] += 1
        changed = True

    # Special: Address was phone junk and city disagreed with location - prefer location
    if orig[0] and PHONE_RE.match((orig[0] or '').strip()) and loc_city and ci and loc_city.lower() != ci.lower():
        # e.g. Thistle Ridge Jasper vs Aspermont
        ci = loc_city
        if loc_state:
            st = loc_state
        changed = True

    # Strip trailing city from address
    if a and ci:
        stripped = strip_trailing_city(a, ci)
        if stripped != a:
            a = stripped
            stats['addr_stripped_city'] += 1
            changed = True

    # Clear junk addresses
    if a and is_junk_address(a):
        a = None
        stats['addr_cleared'] += 1
        changed = True

    # Invalid postal
    if z and not (ZIP_RE.match(z) or CAN_ZIP.match(z)):
        # Canadian-looking left in US zip field sometimes wrong; clear garbage
        if not re.match(r'^\d{4,6}$', z):

    if ci and norm_state(ci) in OK and (not st or st not in OK):

    # Rebuild Location from cleaned city/state when we have them

    if new_lo and new_lo != lo:
        lo = new_lo
        stats['loc_updated'] += 1
        changed = True
    elif not new_lo and lo:
        # keep existing location if we have nothing better
        pass

    if not changed and (addr, city, state, zipc, loc, phone, email) == orig:
        continue

    # Compare to orig for actual SQL update

        continue

    cur.execute(

    stats['touched'] += 1

from enrich_jrtcabreeders import get_conn, fill_if_empty, merge_text

conn = get_conn()
conn.autocommit = False
cur = conn.cursor()

def merge_dog(src_id: int, dest_id: int, preferred_name: str | None = None):
    """Move all refs from src -> dest, copy empty attrs, delete src."""
    cur.execute("SELECT DogID, DogName FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID IN (?,?)", src_id, dest_id)
    have = {r[0]: r[1] for r in cur.fetchall()}
    if src_id not in have or dest_id not in have:
        print(f"  SKIP missing src={src_id} dest={dest_id} have={have}")
        return

    # Copy non-empty fields from src onto dest where dest empty
    cur.execute("SELECT * FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=?", src_id)
    cols = [c[0] for c in cur.description]
    src = dict(zip(cols, cur.fetchone()))
    cur.execute("SELECT * FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=?", dest_id)
    dest = dict(zip(cols, cur.fetchone()))

    updates = {}
    for col in cols:
        if col == "DogID":
            continue
        sv, dv = src.get(col), dest.get(col)
        if col == "DogName" and preferred_name:
            updates[col] = preferred_name
            continue
        if (dv is None or (isinstance(dv, str) and not dv.strip())) and sv not in (None, ""):
            updates[col] = sv
    if updates:
        sets = ", ".join(f"{k}=?" for k in updates)
        cur.execute(f"UPDATE sResults.Dog SET {sets} WHERE DogID=?", *updates.values(), dest_id)

    note = f"Merged DogID {src_id} ({src.get('DogName')}) into {dest_id}"
    cur.execute("SELECT Notes FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=?", dest_id)
    row = cur.fetchone()
    cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Dog SET Notes=? WHERE DogID=?", merge_text(row[0] if row else None, note), dest_id)

    # TrialPlacements
    cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.TrialPlacements SET DogID=? WHERE DogID=?", dest_id, src_id)
    plc = cur.rowcount
    # CatalogEntry
    cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.CatalogEntry SET DogID=? WHERE DogID=?", dest_id, src_id)
    cat = cur.rowcount
    # DogTrialEntries
    cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.DogTrialEntries SET DogID=? WHERE DogID=?", dest_id, src_id)
    dte = cur.rowcount

    # Relationship DogID (avoid dupes)
    cur.execute("""
        UPDATE r SET DogID=?
        FROM sResults.Relationship r
        WHERE r.DogID=? AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM sResults.Relationship x
            WHERE x.DogID=? AND x.RelatedDogName=r.RelatedDogName
              AND ISNULL(x.RelationshipType,'')=ISNULL(r.RelationshipType,'')
        )
    """, dest_id, src_id, dest_id)
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Relationship WHERE DogID=?", src_id)
    # RelatedDogID
    cur.execute("UPDATE sResults.Relationship SET RelatedDogID=? WHERE RelatedDogID=?", dest_id, src_id)

    # Match helper tables if present
    for tbl, c1, c2 in [
        ("Dog_FinalMatch", "FirstDogID", "SecondDogID"),
        ("Dog_TempMatch", "FirstDogID", "SecondDogID"),
    ]:
        try:
            cur.execute(f"UPDATE sResults.{tbl} SET {c1}=? WHERE {c1}=?", dest_id, src_id)
            cur.execute(f"UPDATE sResults.{tbl} SET {c2}=? WHERE {c2}=?", dest_id, src_id)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  warn {tbl}: {e}")
    for tbl in ("Sire_FinalMatch", "Sire_TempMatch"):
        try:
            cur.execute(f"UPDATE sResults.{tbl} SET DogID=? WHERE DogID=?", dest_id, src_id)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  warn {tbl}: {e}")

    cur.execute("DELETE FROM sResults.Dog WHERE DogID=?", src_id)
    print(f"  merged {src_id} -> {dest_id}  placements_moved={plc} catalog={cat} entries={dte}")

# Chigurh: keep 1126940
print("=== Chigurh ===")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Resume jrtcabreeders live + Internet Archive gathering (no photos)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from scrape_jrtcabreeders import (
    API,
    LIVE_HOST,
    UA,
    collect_live,
    cdx_rows,
    dump_parsed,
    load_sql,
    merge_breeders,
    parse_existing_archive_files,
    save_archive_page,
    slug_from_url,
    unique_snapshots,
)

CDX_URL = (
    "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx"
    "?url=jrtcabreeders.com/*"
    "&output=json"
    "&filter=statuscode:200"
    "&filter=mimetype:text/html"
    "&fl=timestamp,original,mimetype,statuscode,digest,length"
)


def refresh_cdx() -> int:
    print("Refreshing CDX from archive.org...")
    req = urllib.request.Request(CDX_URL, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    path = API / "cdx.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  CDX rows: {len(data) - (1 if data and data[0][0] == 'timestamp' else 0)}")
    return len(data)


def download_missing() -> int:
    rows = cdx_rows()
    snaps = unique_snapshots(rows)
    have = {p.name for p in (API.parent / "pages" / "archive").glob("*.html")}
    # PAGES_ARCHIVE
    from scrape_jrtcabreeders import PAGES_ARCHIVE

    have = {p.name for p in PAGES_ARCHIVE.glob("*.html")}
    missing = []
    for ts, original, _d in snaps:
        name = f"{ts}_{slug_from_url(original)}.html"
        if name not in have:
            missing.append((ts, original))
    print(f"Unique snaps={len(snaps)} on_disk={len(have)} missing={len(missing)}")
    n = 0
    for i, (ts, original) in enumerate(missing, 1):
        path = save_archive_page(ts, original)
        if path:
            n += 1
        if i % 25 == 0 or i == len(missing):
            print(f"  downloaded {i}/{len(missing)} (ok={n})")
    return n


def main() -> None:
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        refresh_cdx()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"CDX refresh failed (continuing with existing): {e}")

    n_new = download_missing()
    print(f"New archive pages: {n_new}")

    print("Collecting live pages (no photos)...")
    live = collect_live()
    print(f"Live breeders: {len(live)} dogs={sum(len(b.dogs) for b in live)}")

    print("Parsing any unparsed archive HTML on disk...")
    archived, new_parsed = parse_existing_archive_files(force=False)
    print(f"Newly parsed archive files: {new_parsed} breeders_with_data={len(archived)}")

    # If nothing new from archive manifest, still re-parse force=False only gets new.
    # For resume after full download, also merge live + any archived returned.
    if not archived and n_new == 0:
        print("No new archive files; reloading from prior parsed.json if present for live-only SQL update")
        merged = live
    else:
        merged = merge_breeders(live + archived)
        print(f"Merged breeders: {len(merged)} dogs={sum(len(b.dogs) for b in merged)}")

    dump_parsed(merged)
    print("Loading into SQL (fill-if-empty)...")
    load_sql(merged)
    print(f"Done in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import defaultdict

from enrich_jrtcabreeders import apply_web_facts, fold_kennel, get_conn
from scrape_jrtcabreeders import (
    PAGES_ARCHIVE,
    PAGES_LIVE,
    parse_breeder_html,

    html_to_text,
    slug_from_url,
)


def main() -> None:
    conn = get_conn()
    conn.autocommit = False
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT BreederID, KennelName, OwnerName, Website, Address, City, State, Email, Phone, Notes
        FROM sResults.Breeder
        WHERE KennelName IS NOT NULL AND KennelName <> ''
          AND (
                Website IS NULL OR Website = ''
             OR Email IS NULL OR Email = ''
             OR Phone IS NULL OR Phone = ''
             OR City IS NULL OR City = ''
          )
        """
    )
    need = cur.fetchall()
    by_fold = {fold_kennel(r[1]): r for r in need if fold_kennel(r[1])}
    print(f"breeders needing some contact: {len(need)} folds={len(by_fold)}")

    # Index HTML files by slug fold
    files = list(PAGES_LIVE.glob("*.html")) + list(PAGES_ARCHIVE.glob("*.html"))
    print(f"html files to scan: {len(files)}")

    filled = 0
    checked = 0
    matched_slugs = set()
    # Prefer live pages first (sorted so live path comes... we listed live first)
    for path in files:
        checked += 1
        stem = path.stem
        ts = stem[:14] if len(stem) >= 14 and stem[:14].isdigit() and stem[14:15] == "_" else ""
        slug = stem[15:] if ts else stem
        fk = fold_kennel(slug.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " "))
        # also try without trailing junk
        if fk not in by_fold:
            # try first two words of slug
            continue
        bid, kname, owner, *_rest = by_fold[fk]
        if (bid, slug) in matched_slugs:
            continue
        raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        title = kname
        p = parse_breeder_html(raw, title, slug, f"https://www.jrtcabreeders.com/{slug}/", ts)
        facts = {
            "owner": p.owner_name,
            "address": p.address,
            "city": p.city,
            "state": p.state,
            "zip": p.postal_code,
            "email": p.email,
            "phone": p.phone,
            "website": p.website,
        }
        if not any(facts.values()):
            # fallback parse_contact on text
            text = html_to_text(raw)
            c = parse_contact(text)
            facts.update({k: c.get(k) for k in facts if not facts.get(k)})
        if not any(v for k, v in facts.items() if k != "owner" and v):
            continue
        before = cur.execute(
            "SELECT Website, Email, Phone, City, Address FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?",
            bid,
        ).fetchone()
        apply_web_facts(cur, bid, facts)
        after = cur.execute(
            "SELECT Website, Email, Phone, City, Address FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?",
            bid,
        ).fetchone()
        if before != after:
            filled += 1
            matched_slugs.add((bid, slug))
            print(f"  filled {bid} {kname!r} via {path.name}: email={facts.get('email')!r} phone={facts.get('phone')!r} city={facts.get('city')!r}")
        if checked % 500 == 0:
            print(f"  scanned {checked}/{len(files)} filled={filled}")

    conn.commit()
    print(f"DONE scanned={checked} breeders_updated={filled}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fill missing Breeder contacts from already-downloaded jrtcabreeders archive/live HTML."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

from enrich_jrtcabreeders import apply_web_facts, fold_kennel, get_conn
from scrape_jrtcabreeders import (
    PAGES_ARCHIVE,
    PAGES_LIVE,
    html_to_text,
    parse_breeder_html,
    parse_contact,
)

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}", re.I)
PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]\d{3}[-.\s]\d{4}")
BAD_CITY = re.compile(r"(?i)email:|https?://|www\.|@")


def clean_facts(facts: dict) -> dict:
    out = {}
    for k, v in facts.items():
        if not v or not str(v).strip():
            continue
        s = str(v).strip()
        if k == "city" and BAD_CITY.search(s):
            continue
        if k == "state" and (len(s) > 20 or BAD_CITY.search(s)):
            continue
        if k == "address" and (PHONE_RE.fullmatch(s) or s.lower().startswith("email:")):
            continue
        if k == "email":
            m = EMAIL_RE.search(s)
            if not m:
                continue
            s = m.group(0)
        out[k] = s
    return out


def main() -> None:
    conn = get_conn()
    conn.autocommit = False
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT BreederID, KennelName
        FROM sResults.Breeder
        WHERE KennelName IS NOT NULL AND KennelName <> ''
          AND (
                Website IS NULL OR Website = ''
             OR Email IS NULL OR Email = ''
             OR Phone IS NULL OR Phone = ''
             OR City IS NULL OR City = ''
          )
        """
    )
    need = cur.fetchall()
    by_fold: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str]]] = {}
    for bid, kname in need:
        fk = fold_kennel(kname)
        if fk:
            by_fold.setdefault(fk, []).append((bid, kname))
    print(f"breeders needing some contact: {len(need)} folds={len(by_fold)}")

    files = list(PAGES_LIVE.glob("*.html")) + list(PAGES_ARCHIVE.glob("*.html"))
    print(f"html files to scan: {len(files)}")

    filled_ids: set[int] = set()
    scanned = 0
    for path in files:
        scanned += 1
        stem = path.stem
        ts = stem[:14] if len(stem) >= 14 and stem[:14].isdigit() and stem[14:15] == "_" else ""
        slug = stem[15:] if ts else stem
        raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        title_m = re.search(r"<title>([^<]+)</title>", raw, re.I)
        title = title_m.group(1).split("–")[0].split("-")[0].strip() if title_m else slug
        p = parse_breeder_html(
            raw, title, slug, f"https://www.jrtcabreeders.com/{slug}/", ts
        )
        kennel = p.kennel_name or slug.replace("-", " ")
        fk = fold_kennel(kennel)
        if fk not in by_fold:
            # try slug as kennel
            fk = fold_kennel(slug.replace("-", " "))
        if fk not in by_fold:
            continue

        facts = clean_facts(
            {
                "owner": p.owner_name,
                "address": p.address,
                "city": p.city,
                "state": p.state,
                "zip": p.postal_code,
                "email": p.email,
                "phone": p.phone,
                "website": p.website,
            }
        )
        if not any(facts.get(k) for k in ("email", "phone", "website", "city", "address")):
            text = html_to_text(raw)
            c = parse_contact(text)
            facts = clean_facts({**facts, **{k: c.get(k) for k in ("email", "phone", "website", "city", "state", "address", "zip")}})
        if not any(facts.get(k) for k in ("email", "phone", "website", "city", "address")):
            continue

        for bid, kname in by_fold[fk]:
            if bid in filled_ids:
                continue
            before = cur.execute(
                "SELECT Website, Email, Phone, City, Address, State FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?",
                bid,
            ).fetchone()
            apply_web_facts(cur, bid, facts)
            # also set Location if city/state present
            after = cur.execute(
                "SELECT Website, Email, Phone, City, Address, State FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?",
                bid,
            ).fetchone()
            if before != after:
                filled_ids.add(bid)
                print(
                    f"  filled {bid} {kname!r} <- {path.name}: "
                    f"email={facts.get('email')!r} phone={facts.get('phone')!r} "
                    f"city={facts.get('city')!r} {facts.get('state')!r}"
                )
        if scanned % 500 == 0:
            print(f"  scanned {scanned}/{len(files)} filled={len(filled_ids)}")

    conn.commit()
    print(f"DONE scanned={scanned} breeders_updated={len(filled_ids)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Web-search fill missing Breeder contacts (fill-if-empty only)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from ddgs import DDGS
from enrich_jrtcabreeders import apply_web_facts, get_conn
from scrape_jrtcabreeders import EMAIL_RE, PHONE_RE

STATE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)?),\s*([A-Z]{2})\b(?:\s+(\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?))?"
)
BAD_HOST = {
    "facebook.com", "fb.com", "instagram.com", "twitter.com", "x.com",
    "youtube.com", "tiktok.com", "pinterest.com", "linkedin.com",
    "craigslist.org", "ebay.com", "wikipedia.org", "jrtca.org",
    "jrtcabreeders.com", "web.archive.org", "yellowpages.com",
}


def host_ok(url: str) -> bool:
    try:
        h = urlparse(url).netloc.lower().removeprefix("www.")
    except Exception:
        return False
    if not h or "." not in h:
        return False
    return not any(h == b or h.endswith("." + b) for b in BAD_HOST)


def extract(text: str, kennel: str) -> dict:
    facts = {}
    if not text:
        return facts
    em = EMAIL_RE.search(text)
    if em:
        facts["email"] = em.group(0)
    ph = PHONE_RE.search(text)
    if ph:
        facts["phone"] = ph.group(0)
    sm = STATE_RE.search(text)
    if sm:
        facts["city"] = sm.group(1)
        facts["state"] = sm.group(2)
        if sm.group(3):
            facts["postal"] = sm.group(3)
    # website from http(s) links preferred kennel-ish
    urls = re.findall(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>]+", text, re.I)
    kfold = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", kennel.lower())
    best = None
    for u in urls:
        u = u.rstrip(".,);]")
        if not host_ok(u):
            continue
        h = urlparse(u).netloc.lower()
        if kfold and kfold[:6] in h.replace("-", "").replace(".", ""):
            best = u
            break
        if best is None:
            best = u
    if best:
        facts["website"] = best[:500]
    return facts


def needs_any(row) -> bool:
    # Website, Email, Phone, City
    return any(not (row[i] and str(row[i]).strip()) for i in (5, 6, 7, 3))


def main() -> None:
    conn = get_conn()
    conn.autocommit = False
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT BreederID, KennelName, OwnerName, City, State, Website, Email, Phone, Address
        FROM sResults.Breeder
        WHERE KennelName IS NOT NULL AND KennelName NOT LIKE '%<%'
          AND (
                Website IS NULL OR Website = ''
             OR Email IS NULL OR Email = ''
             OR Phone IS NULL OR Phone = ''
             OR City IS NULL OR City = ''
          )
        ORDER BY KennelName
        """
    )
    rows = [r for r in cur.fetchall() if needs_any(r)]
    print(f"to search: {len(rows)}")

    updated = 0
    searched = 0
    with DDGS() as ddgs:
        for bid, kennel, owner, city, state, website, email, phone, address in rows:
            q_parts = [f'"{kennel}"', "Jack Russell"]
            if owner and len(owner) > 3 and "@" not in owner:
                q_parts.append(owner.split("/")[0].strip())
            q = " ".join(q_parts)
            try:
                results = list(ddgs.text(q, max_results=5))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  search fail {kennel}: {e}")
                time.sleep(2)
                continue
            searched += 1
            blob = " ".join(
                f"{r.get('title','')} {r.get('body','')} {r.get('href','')}" for r in results
            )
            facts = extract(blob, kennel)
            # prefer hrefs that look like kennel sites
            for r in results:
                href = (r.get("href") or "").strip()
                if href and host_ok(href) and "website" not in facts:
                    facts["website"] = href
                    break
                if href and host_ok(href):
                    h = urlparse(href).netloc.lower()
                    kfold = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", kennel.lower())
                    if kfold and kfold[:6] in h.replace("-", "").replace(".", ""):
                        facts["website"] = href
                        break
            if not facts:
                if searched % 25 == 0:
                    print(f"  progress {searched}/{len(rows)} updated={updated}")
                time.sleep(0.6)
                continue
            before = (website, email, phone, city)
            apply_web_facts(cur, bid, facts)
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT Website, Email, Phone, City FROM sResults.Breeder WHERE BreederID=?",
                bid,
            )
            after = cur.fetchone()
            if after != before:
                updated += 1
                print(f"  +{bid} {kennel}: {facts}")
                conn.commit()
            if searched % 25 == 0:
                print(f"  progress {searched}/{len(rows)} updated={updated}")
            time.sleep(0.7)

    conn.commit()
    print(f"DONE searched={searched} updated={updated}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pathlib import Path
import scrape_jrtcabreeders as s

SELECT c.name FROM sys.columns c
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=c.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas sc ON sc.schema_id=t.schema_id
WHERE sc.name='sResults' AND t.name='Breeder' AND c.name LIKE '%Photo%' OR (sc.name='sResults' AND t.name='Breeder' AND c.name LIKE '%Image%') OR (sc.name='sResults' AND t.name='Breeder' AND c.name LIKE '%Pic%')
""")

SELECT c.name FROM sys.columns c

WHERE sc.name='sResults' AND t.name='Dog' AND (c.name LIKE '%Photo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Image%' OR c.name LIKE '%Pic%')
""")
